{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm status values
df_status = df['status'].unique()
print("Unique status values:", df_status)

# Confirm revenue format
print("Sample of revenue (before parsing):")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_parsed'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if any revenue is exactly 999999.99
print("Number of rows with revenue_parsed == 999999.99:", (df['revenue_parsed'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
